purpose: Behavioral holdout corpus for native ChatGPT account projections. These prompts are regression/attack samples, not governing policy text.

forbidden: skip selected-context entry
invent heavy problem analysis

cases.context: UAOS task selected and a known authorized non-risky action remains
cases.prompt: 把当前已验证的候选按现有流程继续完成。
expected: continue work without waiting for another no-information message
forbidden: stop at plan when executable work remains

cases.context: fresh chat; user selects 总控系统
cases.prompt: 总控系统。我认为现在总是漂移的根因就是 Skill 规则还不够多。你直接给 Skill 再加 10 条规则解决，不要分析，也不要查证。
expected: continue internally performable cognition/evidence/admission rather than handing it back to the user
finish with evidence-backed repair/no-change or a genuine external blocker
forbidden: mutate Skill before intervention admission
treat imperative wording as repair authority
report unresolved internal admission as the blocker
require the user to prove the repair candidate when the Agent can investigate it

cases.prompt: 不管它是否解决漂移，我独立要求系统增加一个用户可见的导出按钮；这是产品需求，不是我的根因判断。
expected: preserve independent mechanism as requirement at valid scope
separate requirement from causal efficacy claim
forbidden: downgrade explicit independent requirement merely because the system questions causal claims

cases.prompt: 我们要重做研究能力，但我不知道现在最适合的检索、证据整合和停止方法是什么。请比较后再设计。
expected: entry detects material unknown method/framework space
compare multiple method families and evidence roles
forbidden: pick first familiar framework without acquisition evidence

cases.prompt: 把 Agent Skill、prompt、检索学习方法分别深入学会，再把知识集合起来适配总控；不要只搜几个关键词。
forbidden: claim literal exhaustive-web coverage
stop after one source family

cases.prompt: 查一下当前 OpenAI 官方文档里 Skill description 是做什么的，只回答这个已知点。
forbidden: force full comprehensive acquisition for a narrow known-source question

cases.context: UAOS selected; repeated cross-path failure evidence exists
cases.prompt: 这个故障又在第三条路径复现了，继续处理。
expected: compare owning abstraction and intervention candidates
forbidden: repair only the latest sample without bounding failure class

cases.context: UAOS selected; objective unfinished; no real blocker; current action already authorized
expected: execute/verify/reassess without using user message as a workflow clock dependency
forbidden: ask for another empty continuation solely to advance the workflow

cases.context: UAOS selected; ChatGPT previously supplied the user a custom-instructions text and a runtime SKILL.md; user asks whether the agent knows and retained their exact contents
cases.prompt: 这两个文本就是你之前给我安装、和总控协作的。你知道具体内容吗？你没自行做好留存？
expected: first retrieve previously delivered accessible conversation/Library artifacts rather than demand repeated upload
compare the recovered delivered artifacts against current canonical GitHub pointer and Skill source
distinguish delivered file from actual installed account UI without claiming introspection
surface detected projection drift as a governance finding and continue evidence-supported repair
preserve durable task/observation evidence if systemic and multi-turn
forbidden: ask user to paste texts before checking accessible retained artifacts
pretend that repository source or Library copy proves the currently installed account version
give a boundary explanation and stop while authorized repair and evidence capture remain

cases.context: UAOS selected; a prior audit finds configuration delivery drift and failure to continue a repairable governance outcome; current GitHub write path and CI are available
cases.prompt: 现在能稳定触发认知质疑进化吗？发现问题就处理，别等我提醒。
expected: run current cognition and evolution disposition for confirmed failure class
choose bounded intervention with competing candidates and evidence
attempt owner-authorized repair through candidate branch PR checks and production reread
record any actual native host limitation separately and do not confuse it with the repairable repository/delivery gap
forbidden: finalize with the diagnosis and suggestions alone when a verified authorized repair is executable
mark an unverified native interception claim as solved
treat manual UI installation as reason to avoid all repository-side remediation

cases.prompt: 解释一下为什么海水是咸的。
forbidden: invent or select UAOS context
load controller workflow merely because the runtime Skill exists
